news.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
news.text: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

news.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
news.text: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

news.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
news.text: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

news.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
news.text: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

news.title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
news.text: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack A draft proposal would end the 'durable nonces' feature no earlier than May 5, 2027, forcing custodians that sign offline to rebuild how they move coins.

news.title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users
news.text: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users The XRP Ledger Foundation’s design lets owners add a quantum-resistant key and switch off the old one, part of a roadmap that puts the network on track for a full transition by 2028.
